name: Shining Smite

header.Casting Time: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

casting.casting_time: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike

authored_intent: Bonus Action immediately after melee weapon/Unarmed Strike hit; extra Radiant to hit; hit target sheds Bright Light 5 feet, cannot gain Invisible benefit and attacks against it have Advantage; Concentration and upcast dice.

rules.text: The target hit by the strike takes an extra 2d6 Radiant damage from the attack.
Until the spell ends, the target sheds Bright Light in a 5-foot radius, attack rolls against it have Advantage, and it can’t benefit from the Invisible condition.
The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 2.
